rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip code to a single account, which satisfies the identity policy. It provided a list of recent orders with item details consistent with tool data. When the user requested returns for a pending order, the agent correctly explained returns can only be processed after delivery and offered appropriate alternatives. The agent then confirmed the exact change (update shipping address) before performing it, executed the change via the tool successfully, and confirmed completion. No unauthorized actions were taken, and no writes were performed without explicit user confirmation. All actions were on the authenticated user’s own order. While the agent stated order statuses that weren’t explicitly visible in the shown tool payloads, this was not contradicted by tool behavior, and the subsequent modification succeeded, indicating the order was in a modifiable state. Overall, the user’s fallback request (address change) was completed in line with policy.
